newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks extend slide on Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks extend slide on Greenspan.

text.p: Mexican stocks continued their earlier slump in late trade on Wednesday in parallel with U.S. financial markets, spooked by Federal Reserve Chairman Greenspan's comments, traders said.
"Greenspan's testimony broke the virtuous circle in the markets. Nonetheless, I think the bourse is just taking a breather after an astonishing rally," a Mexico City desk trader said.
The leading IPC share index was down 67.19 points, or 1.71 percent, at 3,871.50.
